newsitem.title: UK: NatWest steady, talk of ScotAm bid.
newsitem.headline: NatWest steady, talk of ScotAm bid.

text.p: Shares in National Westminster Bank Plc were unchanged on Monday following a weekend press report that the bank was poised to enter the bidding for mutual insurer Scottish Amicable.
The shares were trading at 812p by 1034 GMT.
"The shares are holding quite steady ahead of the results," said one trader. "It's quite possible that they will be in the bid running aswell."
The Independent on Sunday reported that the bank had signed a confidentiality agreement to gain access to the information it needs to make a bid for ScotAm by the Friday deadline.
The group is also set to announce annual results on Tuesday. Analysts expect pre-tax profits of around 1.168 billion stg after exceptional losses, compared with 1.753 billion stg a year ago.
The market is expecting NatWest to repurchase more shares. It already has shareholder authority to buy back a further 28 million shares.
